suite.doc: BGP L3VPN over SRv6, per tenant: the route reflector has every PE as an established VPNv4 client and every data-centre LAN of every tenant; every PE imports the other LANs of a tenant into that tenant's VRF only, with an SRv6 SID from the right locator, and the kernel VRF carries them as seg6-encapsulated routes; every CE learns the other LANs of each tenant in that tenant's own VRF, over that VRF's eBGP session.

test.doc: h1 (tenant-a) and h2 (tenant-b) share the CE, the PE and the core, yet the VRFs on the CE and the PE keep them apart: every cross-tenant ping loses 100% and the ICMP never reaches the other host.

test.name: Host traffic between the west and east data centres crosses the transit P router as SRv6-encapsulated IPv6
